title: fix(components,plugin-calendar,plugin-dashboard): every Calendar mount opens on its selected month (objectui#10799)
body:
Fixes #10799
Clause-②: no

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 4 (claim 5858309247, triage 5858019009). This run's session: `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY`.

## What was wrong

react-day-picker (10.0.1) opens on `month`, else `defaultMonth`, else today (its `getInitialMonth` helper), and `selected` does not move it. Every mount of the `Calendar` primitive passed `selected` only, so a value outside the current month opened the picker on today's month. The card's measurement: `CalendarView` on 4 March 2020 with the clock on 27 September 2026, header `March 2020`, popover `September 2026`, no selected day in view. The ablation below reproduces exactly that reading.

## Census (mechanism assumption K1) and the primitive (K3)

A `git grep -nP` over `packages` and `apps` for a JSX `Calendar` element (less-than sign, `Calendar`, word boundary) at base `33e58d8`, with tests and CHANGELOGs set aside, gives nine hits. The import of each decides which `Calendar` it is:

| site | `Calendar` comes from | verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `CalendarView` header popover (`plugin-calendar`) | `@object-ui/components` | the primitive, in scope |
| `ui:calendar` (`renderers/form/calendar.tsx`) | `../../ui` | the primitive, in scope |
| form date picker (`renderers/form/date-picker.tsx`) | `../../ui` | the primitive, in scope |
| `DatePicker` (`custom/date-picker.tsx`) | `../ui/calendar` | the primitive, in scope |
| `DashboardFilterBar` custom-range popover (`plugin-dashboard`) | `@object-ui/components` | the primitive, no `defaultMonth`: in scope by triage note 4 |
| `FieldStub`, `ObjectGrid`, `ViewSwitcher`, `SharedViewLink` (two hits) | `lucide-react` | the icon, excluded |

`@object-ui/components` re-exports `./calendar` from its `ui` barrel. K3 holds: `ui/calendar.tsx` spreads the caller's remaining props onto `DayPicker` last, so `defaultMonth` reaches it. The primitive is untouched: `git diff 33e58d8 -- packages/components/src/ui/` is empty, and `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` passes (50/50).

## What changed, per site (K2: which prop, and why it is enough)

- **`CalendarView` header popover:** `defaultMonth={selectedDate}`. The popover is uncontrolled and Radix unmounts its content on close, so every open remounts `Calendar` and reads the current date. Measured by the pin "every open reads the current date": open (March 2020), Escape, Previous, open again, and the popover reads February 2020.
- **`ui:calendar`:** `defaultMonth={firstSelectedDay(selected)}`, over the selection the renderer already coerces: the day in `single` mode, the first listed day in `multiple` mode, `from` in `range` mode. This mount is inline (no popover), so `defaultMonth` is read once on mount; see acceptance note 4.
- **form date picker:** `defaultMonth={value}`, the same value `selected` reads. That includes an authored ISO string, which reaches `value` unparsed through `SchemaRenderer` (the docs' `with-default-value` example is `"value": "2024-01-15"`); a pin covers that door. The popover remounts on open.
- **`DatePicker`:** `defaultMonth={date}`. The popover remounts on open.
- **`DashboardFilterBar`:** `from` and `to` are parsed once (the parse itself is unchanged) and the range calendar gets `defaultMonth={openingMonth}`, the range's `from`. The popover is controlled and unmounts when closed.

**A day that names no instant passes no month.** Measured with a throwaway probe before writing the guard: `Calendar` with `defaultMonth` set to an Invalid Date throws `RangeError: Invalid time value` and renders nothing, while the same value as `selected` only selects nothing. `ui:calendar` turns an unparseable string into an Invalid Date (through `toDisplayDate`), and the dashboard's `new Date(from)` can produce one, so both sites pass no month for it and still open on today. The two date pickers need no guard: an invalid value already throws in their trigger's `format` call, before the popover exists.

**No shared helper (suggested route not taken).** The condition for it does not hold: three sites pass their one value unchanged, only `ui:calendar` computes a first day over three modes, and the dashboard reads its own `from`. A helper shared with the two plugins would also need a new `@object-ui/components` export, which the claim's `Clause-②: no` rules out.

## Pins (one file per package, one or more cases per site)

The clock is faked for `Date` alone and set to 27 September 2026, in another year than every selected value. Every picker is opened through its real trigger button.

- `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.defaultMonth-10799.test.tsx`: the header button on a 2020 date opens on `March 2020` with `2020-03-04` selected; after Previous the next open reads `February 2020`; a `plugin-calendar:calendar-view` node with an authored `currentDate` opens on its month; control: no date opens on today, the month the header names (real clock, because `CalendarView` reads its default date once at module load).
- `packages/components/src/__tests__/calendar-defaultMonth-10799.test.tsx`: `ui:calendar` single (through `value` and `defaultValue`), multiple, range, an unparseable day (opens on today, does not throw) and the no-value control; the form date picker with a `Date` value, with an ISO-string `value` through `SchemaRenderer`, and the control; `DatePicker` with a date and the control.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardFilterBar.defaultMonth-10799.test.tsx`: a 2020 range opens on `March 2020` / `April 2020`; an unparseable `from` opens on today; control: no range opens on today. ⚠️ This file renders the popover's content inline (it mocks `Popover`, `PopoverTrigger` and `PopoverContent` from `@object-ui/components` as pass-throughs). The filter's own select cannot open this calendar on a stored range at all; see acceptance note 1. So this pin reads the mount itself, not the door.

## Ablation (committed first, then mutated; restore by `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`)

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs --hold` (anchor hits 1 then 0, blob hash changed), then an on-disk `grep -c` of the removed text read 0 in every file. The restore leg, run by an EXIT/INT/TERM trap, proved `git diff HEAD` empty and every blob hash equal to HEAD's. No build is in this loop: the root vitest config aliases `@object-ui/components` to `packages/components/src`, and the rest are relative imports.

| leg | mutation | result | expected |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1, at `e22bfd6` | delete `defaultMonth=…` at all five sites | **10 failed / 7 passed (17)**; every failure reads `expected 'September 2026' to be 'March 2020'` or the same shape | the 10 non-control cases red; 5 controls and 2 invalid-day cases green |
| 2, at `c5d6e48` | drop the validity guard in `ui:calendar` and the dashboard | **2 failed / 14 passed (16)**, both `RangeError: Invalid time value` | exactly the two invalid-day cases red |

Leg 2 ran before the ISO-string `date-picker` case was added, hence 16.

## Verification (HEAD `e22bfd6`)

- The three pin files: 17 passed.
- Package suites, repo-root form: `plugin-calendar` + `plugin-dashboard`: `Test Files 190 passed (190)`, `Tests 1640 passed`. `components`, run in five slices because of the foreground cap: 66 + 71 + 62 + 59 + 61 = 319 files (the package's full count), all passed; 1 file and 17 cases skipped (the date-only zone pins, which only run in a forks child).
- `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` (drives the `ui:calendar` zone pin in a forks child): 6 passed.
- `type-check` (hyphen, name echoed) for `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-calendar`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: each exit 0, 0 `error TS`, after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build` with the `^...` filters for the two plugins: 14/14 tasks).
- eslint on the eight touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config --format json`): 8 files, 0 errors, 46 warnings, and the per-file counts are identical to base for all five source files (the test files have none).
- Gates, each with its own exit code: `check-vi-mock-specifiers` 0, `check-vi-mock-inherit` 0, `check-vi-mock-override-shape` 0 (the dashboard pin adds a partial `vi.mock`), `check-test-path-roots` 0, `check-control-bytes` 0, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` 0 (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `check-changeset-presence` 0, `check-changeset-no-major` 0, `check-changeset-overwrite` 0, `check-changeset-claims` 0, `check-pending-changeset-literals` 0, `check-doc-fence-languages` 0, `check-doc-example-ids` 0, `check-doc-component-types` 0, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` stopped with its own `PRECONDITION NOT MET (exit 2)`, because it needs a 34-package build. The two doc edits add prose only, no fenced code.
- `check-changeset-claims` names two pending changesets that mention `renderers/form/calendar.tsx`. Both say `ui:calendar` registers under exactly that key with `skipFallback`, which this change leaves true.

## Acceptance notes (out of scope here, reported to the seat)

1. **The dashboard's custom range cannot be reopened once set.** The "Custom…" item opens the calendar through the select's `onValueChange`. With a custom range stored, the select's value already is that item, and Radix's controllable state does not fire the callback for an unchanged value. Measured through the real select (user-event): with a stored range, the calendar never appeared (0 captions at any time); from a preset, the same click opened it (2 captions). So `defaultMonth` at this site takes effect only once that is repaired.
2. **The dashboard parses a date-only range as UTC.** `new Date('2026-09-15')` is UTC midnight. Measured in a forks probe with `TZ=America/Los_Angeles`: clicking 15 September commits `{ from: '2026-09-15', to: '2026-09-15' }` (correct), but the calendar highlights 14 September; the UTC control highlights the 15th. This is the date-only family `toDisplayDate` covers elsewhere. The opening month added here reads the same parsed `from` as `selected`, so it opens where the highlight is. West of UTC, a range starting on the 1st opens one month early, and the two-month view still shows the start month.
3. Observation, not measured in a real browser: in happy-dom, "Custom…" picked from a preset opens the popover, and it is gone within 150 ms.
4. `ui:calendar` reads `defaultMonth` on mount. A `value` that changes after mount does not move the displayed month. That is the lighter prop the pins need; a controlled `month` would move month state into the renderer.
